response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS o FROM telescopes) SELECT st.observstation, st.avg_bw AS avg_bandusagepct, st.avg_bw - overall.o AS diff_above_overall FROM st, overall WHERE st.avg_bw > overall.o ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10
